boundary: This is a finite exceptional-fold/voltage model. The C4 phase labels are graph phases, not physical time or optical phase.
lift_rule: Apply the C4 generator simultaneously to source and target. Offsets are phases from the displayed representative; D phases are modulo 2 and E has one phase.
theorem: The full directed automorphism group of the outer-doily transfer graph is exactly the fixed subgroup Fix(alpha) of the exceptional S6 outer automorphism. It is generated by (0 1 4 5)(2 3), hence is C4. Its action on duads gives the orbit decomposition 4+4+4+2+1, and the unique loop is the fixed duad {2,3}. The displayed five-vertex graph-of-groups voltage data reconstructs all 45 arcs.
tutte_coxeter_fold: The graph is the one-part exceptional fold T=P^T D of the Tutte-Coxeter Levi graph. Its residual C4 symmetry is exactly Fix(alpha), not an accidental graph automorphism.
